name: JS Global Lifestyle Company Limited
summary: JS Global Lifestyle Company Limited engages in the design, manufacture, marketing, distribution, and export of small kitchen electrical appliances in Mainland China, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, and internationally. It operates in two segments: Joyoung and SharkNinja APAC. The company offers cooking appliances, including rice cookers, pressure cookers, induction cookers, air fryers, and other appliances and utensils for cooking; and food preparation appliances, such as high-performance multifunctional blenders, soymilk makers, food processors, and other small household appliances that facilitate the food preparation process.
